Kauppahalli.author: Estormiz
observations: The visible hall has red-brick walls with pale trim and a raised pointed entrance gable.
Tall pointed-arch openings repeat along the visible side, with pale green window frames.
The pitched roof is dark metal, with a long raised glazed strip and a decorative ridge railing.
The visible entrance is framed by a large pale-trimmed arch; brick piers project at the corners.
The bronze Toripolliisi figure stands separately in the paved square to the right of the entrance in this view.
The square has visibly patterned stone paving. Furniture and construction fencing shown in this winter photograph are time-dependent.
gaps: Original procedural hall and statue now implemented; exact curved gable, carved relief, measured heights, complete window counts and unseen annexes remain provisional.
Trees, paving bands, signs and furniture are photo-estimated; species, surveyed placement and small sign wording remain unverified.

Oulun tuomiokirkko.author: Leonhard Lenz
observations: The visible front is warm yellow render with white cornices, pilasters and window trim.
The entrance tower has several stepped rectangular stages, a clock, and a dark tapering spire with a gold sphere and cross.
Two round white columns support the small triangular pediment over the entrance.
Stone entrance steps have dark handrails; tall arched openings are visible on the side wings.
gaps: The draft extrusion does not reproduce the tower stages, clock, spire, entrance columns or front steps.
This front photograph does not establish dimensions or the appearance of hidden sides.

Oulun kaupungintalo.author: Estormiz
observations: The visible main front has ochre walls, pale window surrounds and horizontal bands, and a dark roof.
Two prominent rounded roof pavilions carry thin decorative finials.
The projecting central front has three arched entrance openings, broad steps with dark railings, and tall pilasters framing the upper windows.
The garden foreground contains patterned paving, low planting beds and ornate multi-arm lamps.
gaps: Fine relief, side and rear ornament, garden planting and exact architectural profiles remain simplified.
Elevated comparison pose and lens field of view remain estimates; municipal source provides LOD1 height, not detailed current roof measurements.

ownReference.author: zaw-ye-tun
observations: The owner photograph confirms ochre rendered walls, pale horizontal bands and trim, paired roof pavilions and dark roof covering.
Several upper and lower window styles differ; a regular invented grid would not match the central front.
ownReference.applied: Ochre wall appearance, twin-pavilion silhouette, central pilasters, entrance arches and stair proportions guide the custom model; all detailed geometry is interpreted.

Isokatu 37.author: zaw-ye-tun
observations: The photographed front carries visible address number 37, matched to OSM way 871741305.
Visible upper walls have tan brick and pale continuous horizontal window bands; frames have a muted green edge.
The ground floor is glazed commercial frontage; parked vehicles obscure much of its lower detail.
Isokatu 37.applied: Observed wall colour and material only.
gaps: Photograph cuts the top of the building: total height and storeys are not established.
Exact window bands and shopfront geometry have not been authored; existing placeholder bays stay labelled provisional.

Oulu city buses.author: zaw-ye-tun
observations: The photographed OSL bus has a pink body with dark front/side glazing and pale graphics.
Snow, ice and winter light alter the apparent paint colour.
Oulu city buses.applied: Approximate pink paint; removed the shared HSL-style circle motif for Oulu city buses.
gaps: Current shared bus body is generic, not an exact BYD body reconstruction.
Fleet-wide consistency has not been confirmed from a single bus photo.
